whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.content: Who's the Chad ? is a gaming platform developed as part of the 42 Belgium curriculum. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use and protect personal information.

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
items: Password (hashed and never stored in plain text)

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use essential cookies exclusively for authentication, session management and security. We do not use advertising cookies or analytics cookies.

publicInformation.title: Public Information
publicInformation.content: Usernames, profile pictures, rankings, achievements and game statistics may be visible to other users of the platform.

oauthProviders.title: OAuth Providers
oauthProviders.content: Users may authenticate using GitHub or 42. Authentication through these providers is subject to their own privacy policies and terms.

gdprRights.title: GDPR Rights
items: Lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (APD/GBA)

exercisingRights.title: Exercising Your Rights
exercisingRights.content: To exercise any of the rights listed above, including requesting deletion of your account and data, please contact us using the email address below or use the account deletion option in your profile settings, if available.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.content: We process your personal data on the basis of contract performance (to provide you with access to the platform and its features) and legitimate interest (to maintain security, prevent abuse and improve the service).

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your personal data for as long as your account remains active. If you request account deletion, your personal data is permanently deleted within 30 days, except where retention is required to comply with legal obligations.

ageRequirement.title: Age Requirement
ageRequirement.content: This platform is intended for users aged 16 and above, or the minimum age of digital consent in your country of residence. We do not knowingly collect personal data from individuals below this age.

acceptanceOfTerms.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptanceOfTerms.content: By creating an account or using Who's the Chad ?, you agree to these Terms of Service.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.content: Users are responsible for ensuring that their use of the platform complies with applicable laws and regulations.

ageRequirement.title: Age Requirement
ageRequirement.content: You must be at least 16 years old, or the minimum age of consent in your jurisdiction, to create an account and use Who's the Chad ?.

userAccounts.title: User Accounts
items: You are responsible for your account credentials.
You must not share your account with others.
You must provide accurate information when registering.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
items: Do not attempt unauthorized access to the platform.
Do not exploit bugs or vulnerabilities.
Do not interfere with platform operation.
Do not use automated systems to abuse the service.
Do not upload unlawful or offensive content.

rankingsAndStatistics.title: Rankings and Statistics
rankingsAndStatistics.content: Game results, rankings, achievements and statistics may be displayed publicly to other users of the platform.

userContent.title: User Content
userContent.content: Users retain ownership of profile pictures and other content they upload. By uploading content, users grant Who's the Chad ? a non-exclusive license to store, process and display such content for operation of the platform.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: The platform, software, branding, design and related materials remain the property of the Who's the Chad ? team unless otherwise stated.

accountSuspension.title: Account Suspension
accountSuspension.content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or that threaten the security or integrity of the platform.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: The service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without warranties of any kind.

limitationOfLiability.title: Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Who's the Chad ? shall not be liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from use of the platform.

changesToTerms.title: Changes to These Terms
changesToTerms.content: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms. The "Last Updated" date above reflects the most recent revision.

severability.title: Severability
severability.content: If any provision of these Terms is found to be unenforceable or invalid, that provision shall be limited or eliminated to the minimum extent necessary, and the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.content: These Terms shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Belgium.

about.title: Who's the Chad ?
about.description: A web platform for primitive minigames built around knowledge and reflection. A fun way to learn things, train your brain, or compete with friends. Built by a team of 5 as part of the 42 curriculum.
projectModules: Use a framework for both frontend and backend
Allow users to interact with other users
Use an ORM for the database
Custom-made design system with reusable components
A gamification system to reward users for their actions
